architecture.power_path: USB-C 5V -> BQ24074 IN/OUT with protected 1S battery on BAT; OUT -> TPS259531 current guard -> TPS61088 -> TPS22918 -> 5V_MAIN. Always-on TLV75533 before main switch. Conditional low-power branch.
architecture.usb_a: single host port, protected switched VBUS; no hub required
architecture.usb_c: sink only; CC current detection; no USB data or PD voltage request

fpc.connector_dim_evidence: Hirose drawing pp1,5; dimensions include tolerances per drawing
fpc.assembly_configuration: Straight/unfolded tail in bottom-contact connector. Copper exposed on panel-back side; PCB/component face toward that exposed side. Pin 1 must follow back-view drawing; do not mirror from front view. A 180-degree folded tail requires a changed connector/placement review, not stretching this layout.
fpc.insertion_note: Fully insert 0.30mm stiffened tail, close latch, inspect continuity. Do not add a generic FFC as if it were the panel tail.

electrical.buffer: 2 x SN74AHC125PWR, supplied from dedicated switched 3.3V LDO
electrical.extmode: Tie EXTMODE to switched LCD VDD for hardware inversion; NOT MCU 3.3V logic.
electrical.logic_margin: AHC VOL<=0.1V at 50uA at 3V supply test; screen VIL<=0.15V. VOH>=2.9V at 50uA vs VIH>=2.7V. Keep total static output load <=50uA, no strong pullups or LEDs; verify edges and ground drop at FPC.

timing_default.note: Datasheet fEXTCOMIN 1-20Hz, frame 1-20Hz. Maintain COM when Linux stalls; assert DISP low on failure before stopping COM.

electrical.decoupling: Sharp example: VDDA >=0.1uF, VDD >=1uF, DISP-GND 0.1uF. Review DISP edge and sequencing with that capacitor; do not blindly add equivalent capacitance to SPI/COM. Each IC bypass 100nF, LDO input/output >=1uF effective.
electrical.sequencing: DISP low and all signal outputs benign until LCD rails valid. Start COM, clear/update panel, then DISP high. On shutdown blank/clear per Sharp timing, DISP low, isolate buffers, then remove main power. LCD input overshoot must stay within absolute limits.

500mA外设预算（推荐），重新选定较大电流电池连接、供电路径和主开关，不承诺现有功率器件全部保留。

Obtain legible manufacturer exact B2B-PH-K-S drawing from another authoritative copy before marking the electrical BOM ready; current series PDF drops numeric labels. No user approval of a guessed footprint.

supply_risks.description: Current 1S/PH/charger/disconnect chain is a low-power candidate, not a verified 5V 2.5A Pi supply. USB load-class decision is pending; no unrestricted load or seamless-switch guarantee.
Exact DH01 stock 0 at lookup; DH01A is not an approved substitute. Shared supplier A-suffix PDF rejected.

p4 6A cell characteristic conflicts with p7 assembled PCM trip 2.5-4.5A; PH connector rated 2A (JST AWG24 test). p9 labels black (+), red (-), contrary to usual colors. Never infer polarity from wire color; incoming voltage/polarity measurement and keyed harness verification required.
SparkFun shipping restrictions apply; no stock quantity established. Verify actual received DTP605068-3P pack revision.
85x115x40mm remains a provisional layout target; battery 51x73x20mm before allowances may drive envelope. No CAD or exact Pi STEP verified.
Manufacturer confirms exact B2B-PH-K-S family; detailed PDF renders without text labels; dedicated drawing behind email registration. PCB stage must obtain legible exact land pattern, not guess it.

This is a functional selection BOM, not PCB population or ordering CSV. All decoupling, bias, feedback, compensation, ESD power clamps, footprints and quantities must be enumerated before PCB fabrication.

One boot microSD required, target 32GB A1/class10. SDSQUA4-032G-GN6MA catalog search lacked exact row and manufacturer page rendered another capacity; not falsely marked selected. Stock/price and exact card procurement remain advisory to board design.
Runtime, boot transients, source removal, charging heat, low-battery shutdown, signal levels, FPC insertion and USB ESD remain untested.

power.guard_requirement: Worst-case efuse limit plus always-on draw must remain below 2A; select resistor using full tolerance curves, not nominal formula alone. Protect before boost to bound battery path. No claim that the IC switching-current rating equals system output rating.
power.official_pi_supply: 5V DC 2.5A in official brief p3; low-power branch requires boot/workload evidence, not equivalent rating.
power.charger_input_limit: At most 1.5A including setting tolerance, only after CC advertises >=1.5A. 3A advertisement does not increase BQ24074 capability.
power.usb_c_default_current: No enumeration or BC1.2 on power-only D+/D-. On default/unknown advertisement, conservative 100mA input mode, battery-assisted operation and charging disabled; dedicated >=1.5A Type-C source required for normal simultaneous use/charge.
power.thermal: Linear charger at 0.5A has approx (5-3.4)*0.5=0.8W cell-charge dissipation alone, plus system path heat. Copper spreading, exposed-pad vias and enclosure tests required; reduce charge current thermally.
power.temperature: 103AT-2 on TS, plus independent 103AT-2 divider to supervisor ADC. Charge enabled only after valid sensors; candidate firmware window 5-40C to stay inside cell 0-45C. CE default disables charging; watchdog/fault returns disabled. Sensor open/short tests mandatory.
power.current_guard_variant: TPS259531: 5.7V clamp, auto-retry, no QOD. Used as low-voltage input current guard, NOT as sufficient 5.5V-output overvoltage protection for LCD.

runtime_budget.status: Calculation only. Capacity to early shutdown, Pi power and conversion efficiency are unmeasured. Keep user 2h requirement unchanged; keyboard runtime separate.

battery.dimensions_evidence: product/references/battery-sparkfun-6ah.pdf p9; p4 describes individual cells, NOT full pack

value.retention: nonconductive tray/strap, no screw compression, no sharp edges, no heat source touching pack

battery.polarity: p9 color/polarity labels unusual; fixed board BAT+ must be matched by measured incoming pack pin polarity, not color.

compute.frame: top view as official p4, origin lower-left board edge, +x right,+y up
compute.mounting_note: Hole diameter and component heights not dimensioned here; obtain exact mechanical data in CAD. Pi mounted independently, not a soldered HAT; leave antenna region away from battery and metal.

ports.connections: A4/A9/B4/B9 VBUS; A1/A12/B1/B12 GND; A5 CC1 and B5 CC2 separately to TUSB320LAI sink; DP/DN and SBU NC. Do not add duplicate Rd in parallel with controller termination.

ports.drawing: product/references/ss-52100-001.pdf p1, CT520004 A0; supplier 002 PDF rejected
ports.connections: Single Pi OTG host -> custom short data cable -> D+/D- ESD -> Type A socket. VBUS from TPS2553; no hub, no data path to USB-C.

controls.button_centers: Deferred to PCB placement; not inferred from reference images.

supervisor.bod: Enable appropriate brownout and watchdog for this voltage/clock; no 20MHz claim at 3.3V.
supervisor.gpio_budget: 17 of 18 I/O planned: UPDI 1, power key 1, request/ack/status TX/RX 4, battery+independent NTC ADC 2, charger CE 1, input-mode select 1 (EN1 fixed low; EN2 selects 100mA/ILIM), CHG 1, CC I2C 2 (poll, no IRQ), COM/DISP 2, main EN 1, boost EN 1. PGOOD testpoint only. Exact peripheral mux assignment still required in schematic.
supervisor.domain_crossing: 4 x SN74LVC1G07, each powered from its sender domain; outputs pulled up only to receiving domain. Never pull Pi GPIO to always-on rail. Measure off-state leakage; no direct push-pull MCU -> unpowered Pi.

shutdown_defaults.qualification: Thresholds/hysteresis provisional and load-dependent; voltage is not an accurate fuel gauge. Request Linux sync/shutdown then wait acknowledgement; timeout or critical voltage is emergency cut with data-loss risk.

supervisor.off_state: Main switch off plus boost EN off; AON low-power sleep, charging/CC remain supervised. No claim of zero battery drain.

pcb_handoff_tasks: Resolve the pending load-class decision before circuit implementation.
Enumerate every resistor/capacitor, compensator, current setpoint and power-rail protection; current values here are requirements, not final populated schematic.
Read all relevant typical application/layout sections; assign pins, package land patterns and full electrical evidence before routing.
Obtain a legible exact JST footprint; do not use unlabeled render or infer pad drill from pitch.
Perform boost stability and thermal design at minimum battery voltage, inrush/current-limit tolerance, cold-start and USB attach tests.
Model final released PCB and real Pi mounting details in CAD only in an authorized later query.
